book_title: A Natural History of Unnatural Things
author: Daniel   Cohen
book_description: Real seller with inventory on hand. Hard Cover. McCall Publishing Company, 1971. Very Good / Very Good. First Edition Ex-library book with the usual stamps and markings. Interior pages clean and unmarked with a tight binding. 148 pages. Many illustrations. Chapters on witches, werewolves, vampires, demons & the devil, giants, fairies and the wee folk, mummies and zombies and "man-made" monsters .
